doctorEvaluation.title: Doctor Evaluation
doctorEvaluation.description: Based on the provided information, please fill in a professional medical assessment

step2.progressionDescription: Pain progressed from mild to severe, especially at night

step3.detailedDescription: Persistent right lower quadrant pain for 3 days with mild fever (37.5°C) and loss of appetite. Pain is dull and persistent, occasionally becoming severe. Worsens with activity, slightly relieved by lying down.
step3.progression: Day 1: mild and tolerable; Day 2: worsened and affected work; Day 3: severe pain, unable to carry out normal activities.
step3.dailyLifeImpactDetails: Unable to work normally, sleep quality severely reduced, appetite markedly decreased.
step3.previousTreatments: Took painkiller (Ibuprofen 400mg), moderate effect; pain returns 2-3 hours later.

step4.chronicConditionsDescription: Hypertension for 5 years, well controlled with medication, blood pressure stable at 130/85 mmHg.

step6.examDetails: Ultrasound on 2024-01-12 at Peking Union Medical College Hospital showed swelling of right lower abdominal soft tissue and abnormal echo in the appendix region.
step6.labResults: CBC: elevated WBC 15.2×10⁹/L (normal 4-10), neutrophils 85% (normal 50-70%). CRP 45 mg/L (normal <10).
step6.imagingDescription: Ultrasound imaging taken 2024-01-12 shows appendix enlarged to 12mm.
step6.filesProvisionNotes: Can provide electronic exam reports and imaging files.

step7.budgetNotes: Can adjust slightly; prioritize treatment efficacy
step7.timingConstraints: Work schedule is tight, hopes to proceed soon
step7.additionalNotes: Hopes to arrange soon; worsening pain severely impacts work and life. If surgery is needed, would like to understand recovery and precautions.
